lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: November 2030. HKU Shanghai. Four towers. One core. An entire campus wired as a single supercomputer.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Last night, something else got inside it. The barrier sealed. The guardian lion turned. And the students at the High Table Dinner never came home.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You are the only Student Ambassador still moving, and your MacBook still has root.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Restore the four towers. Free the students. Bring CDS back online.
